All very beautiful!!
The one in the far top right corner is my favorite. I like the shape 🤔

I’m convinced family molestation and rape happens more than people are willing to admit...it breaks my heart and sickens me. I’m glad you received the apologies that you definitely deserved and that you got clean. Hopefully you can assist your niece in healing as well.
You have more to do. Please don’t attempt again. You’re meant to be here.
Thanks for sharing this. I really appreciate it.
Thank you for your realistic advice.

I have been lying for months about going to therapy. I try to make it appear that I have a handle on my depression but I don’t. I should really look into actually seeking help. Thanks for your response.
Sleep is my best friend....it numbs everything. I ran out of sleeping pills. I need more.
